premise.claim: RBG admission requests fail briefly (connection refused / timeout) at the moment an old controller-manager Pod is deleted, because on SIGTERM the manager stops the webhook server on :9443 at once while kube-proxy and the API server keep sending the Pod new connections until they observe it terminating; every RBG webhook has failurePolicy: Fail.
premise.reportedComponent: controller manager Deployment in deploy/helm/rbgs and deploy/kubectl/manifests.yaml (built from config/manager)
premise.evidence: Mechanism verified on base code: no preStop hook in base manifests; controller-runtime v0.22.1 webhook server closes listeners immediately on ctx cancel (vendor/sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/webhook/server.go:243-256); all 6 webhooks failurePolicy: Fail in both install paths; GracefulShutdownTimeout unset in cmd/rbgs so default 30s applies (vendor .../pkg/manager/internal.go:55). Live kind reproduction not run this round (no KUBECONFIG); issue #583 carries measured base failures (1/2839 Helm, 3/2692 kubectl).

findings.description: Helm chart manager Deployment drains before shutdown: exec preStop /bin/sleep N (N>0) and terminationGracePeriodSeconds >= N+30.
Kustomize base config/manager/manager.yaml (source of deploy/kubectl/manifests.yaml) carries the same preStop drain and grace period.

cmd/rbgs manager options leave GracefulShutdownTimeout nil in every webhook mode (round-2 delta 1db0e04b..011c0043, commit 011c0043 'pin the 30s shutdown budget'): so the 35 = 5 + 30 arithmetic asserted by the chart tests stays valid. Directly remediates prior finding F3-shutdown-constant-drift.

extraChecks.description: deploy/kubectl/manifests.yaml regenerates byte-identically from kustomize build config/default (kubectl kustomize used as kustomize CLI proxy; byte-fidelity itself verified on base first).

Round-2 delta adds YAML comments to config/manager/manager.yaml and the Helm template; comments must not leak into rendered output: deploy/kubectl/manifests.yaml still byte-identical to kustomize build config/default, and helm render unchanged apart from nothing (comments are stripped).
extraChecks.evidence: results/kustomize-sync-round2.txt (KUSTOMIZE-SYNC: identical at 011c0043), results/helm-render-r2-diff.txt (rendered Deployment delta is only the 3 comment lines)

liveNote: L3 (skipped this round, no KUBECONFIG): on a kind cluster, run the issue #583/#575 harness — server-side dry-run RoleBasedGroup creates at ~75ms intervals while `kubectl -n rbgs-system rollout restart deployment/rbgs-controller-manager` runs; expect 0 `failed calling webhook` errors over >=5 rollouts per install path (base shows 1/2839 and 3/2692).
